en.title: Delta's First Airbus A350-1000 Appears in Full Livery Ahead of June 2027 Debut
en.summary: Delta Air Lines' first Airbus A350-1000 has been spotted in full livery at Airbus' Toulouse facility, manufacturer serial number 841, ahead of a planned June 2027 commercial debut; Delta ordered 20 of the type in January 2024.
body: The first Airbus A350-1000 for Delta Air Lines has been spotted in full airline livery at Airbus' facility in Toulouse, France, providing the first public look at the widebody as it approaches completion. Aviation photography outlet Airways Magazine shared the sighting on November 9, with photographs credited to aircraft spotter Eurospot. The aircraft is the first of the A350-1000s Delta has ordered, and its appearance marks a significant milestone ahead of the airline's planned June 2027 commercial debut.

Delta originally announced the order in January 2024, becoming the first US airline to commit to the largest version of Airbus' A350 family. The aircraft will become the largest in Delta's fleet. The first A350-1000 is identified in aviation tracking reports as manufacturer serial number 841. The aircraft still needs to progress through engine installation, ground checks and flight testing before delivery. Delta's official A350 media kit currently lists early 2027 as the start of deliveries, while industry reporting has pointed to June as the intended commercial launch period. Delta has 20 aircraft on firm order, with the possibility of expanding the commitment through additional options.

Delta will introduce its next-generation Delta One business-class suites on the A350-1000, with a reverse-herringbone layout, window-side suites facing outward and center suites offering a movable privacy divider. The updated product includes a flat-bed seat more than six-and-a-half feet (1.98 meters) long and a 24-inch (60.96 centimeters) high-definition seatback screen. The cabin will have 53 Delta One seats, 48 Premium Select seats and 213 Comfort+ and Main Cabin seats, a 50% premium seat mix. Powered by Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines, the A350-1000 has a published range of up to approximately 8,700 nautical miles (16,112 km) and is expected to deliver more than 20% lower fuel burn per available seat mile than the aircraft it is intended to replace. Simple Flying reported the aircraft is expected to debut on routes to Seoul from Atlanta and Detroit, though Delta has not publicly confirmed the first destinations.

zh.title: 達美航空首架A350-1000完成全套塗裝，2027年6月投入營運
zh.summary: 達美航空首架空中巴士A350-1000已在土魯斯完成全套塗裝並曝光，製造商序號841，預計2027年6月投入商業營運；達美於2024年1月訂購20架，將成為其機隊中最大的機型。
body: 達美航空首架空中巴士A350-1000已在空中巴士土魯斯廠區完成全套塗裝並曝光。航空攝影媒體Airways Magazine於11月9日分享了這次目擊消息，照片由飛機攝影師Eurospot拍攝。這是達美訂購的A350-1000中的首架，距離預計2027年6月商業首航又邁進一步。
達美於2024年1月宣布訂購，成為首家承諾引進A350系列最大機型的美國航空公司；此機型將成為達美機隊中最大的飛機。該機在航空追蹤報告中的製造商序號為841，交付前仍須完成發動機安裝、地面檢查與飛行測試等步驟。達美官方A350媒體資料列出2027年初開始交付，業界報導則指向6月為預計商業首航期。達美共訂購20架，並可透過選擇權擴大承諾。

新機將導入達美新一代Delta One商務艙套房，採反魚骨式佈局，窗邊套房朝外，中央套房設有可移動隔板；座椅全平躺長度逾6.5英尺（1.98公尺），配備24英寸（60.96公分）高畫質座椅背螢幕。客艙配置為Delta One商務艙53個、Premium Select特選經濟艙48個、Comfort+優悅經濟艙與主艙213個，豪華座位占比達50%。A350-1000採用勞斯萊斯Trent XWB-97發動機，公布航程約8700海里（16112公里），每可用座位英里燃油消耗較其取代的機型低逾20%。Simple Flying報導，該機預計由亞特蘭大與底特律首航首爾航線，但達美尚未公開確認首批航點。
